head: a1b5a338251a636b143a013c96e186fd8b96441b
verdict: NOT READY — CRITICAL PRODUCTION CONFIGURATION GAPS

environments.runtimeServiceAccount: default compute service account for 8/9 scoped functions
environments.risk: Production selection depends on a default Firebase alias; Functions are stale while the Vercel frontend is current.
Preview deployments exist for feature/test branches, but no isolated Firebase project, bucket, or runtime identity is declared.
No staging alias or governed staging environment was found.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Dedicated, explicit Preview/Staging/Production projects and policies
controls.environmentActual: One default Firebase project is configured; Preview deployments have no declared isolated backend
controls.remediation: Define distinct project aliases, runtime identities, buckets, policies, and promotion gates per environment.
controls.verification: Repeat the environment inventory with explicit project IDs and prove data/runtime isolation.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Production commands select a reviewed project explicitly
controls.environmentActual: Firebase default is aura-control-center-debb3 while the active gcloud project is aura-hcm; functions deploy script has no explicit project
controls.remediation: Require explicit project/environment arguments and a promotion authority gate.
controls.verification: Static-check deployment commands and run a credential-free dry-run in each environment.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Known public and control-center applications
controls.environmentActual: Two active Web Apps are registered: Aura Nexus Public and Aura Control Center
controls.remediation: Maintain an approved app inventory per environment.
controls.verification: Re-list apps and compare IDs/display names to the approved inventory.

controls.control: App Check provider and service enforcement
controls.repositoryExpectation: Approved provider and verified enforcement on Functions, Firestore, and Storage
controls.environmentActual: App Check API queries returned HTTP 403; source requires an App Check context on scoped callables, but deployed effective enforcement cannot be established
controls.remediation: Grant read-only App Check configuration access and verify provider, enforcement, metrics, and replay protection.
controls.verification: Repeat metadata queries with a least-privilege auditor identity.

controls.repositoryExpectation: No production debug bypass
controls.environmentActual: Aura Nexus Public has one registered debug token; Aura Control Center has zero
controls.remediation: Identify the owner/context, revoke the production debug token under change control, and verify audit history.
controls.verification: Re-list debug token metadata and confirm zero for Production apps.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Enabled TTL matching the versioned seven-day/24-hour lifecycle contract
controls.environmentActual: Firestore reports zero TTL field configurations
controls.remediation: Review and apply the certified TTL manifest in a separate authorized change.
controls.verification: Query TTL metadata until the field is ACTIVE, then verify lag/cardinality alerts.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Versioned index manifest aligned to production queries
controls.environmentActual: Remote index count is zero and firestore.indexes.json is absent
controls.remediation: Derive bounded query indexes, version the manifest, and review redundant/index-building risk.
controls.verification: Compare the committed manifest and remote READY indexes.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Deployed ruleset exactly matches a reviewed repository ruleset
controls.environmentActual: Firebase Rules API returned HTTP 403; deployed ruleset hash is unavailable
controls.remediation: Grant ruleset read access and compare normalized hashes before any deploy.
controls.verification: Retrieve release/ruleset metadata read-only and prove exact normalized match.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Clients cannot write platform_global_admins, platform_tenants, or server-owned Discovery state
controls.environmentActual: Local firestore.rules grants any authenticated user read/write on platform_global_admins and platform_tenants; deployed status is unknown
controls.remediation: Block deployment of the current rules, redesign authority writes as backend-only, and extend Rules certification.
controls.verification: Emulator adversarial tests plus exact deployed-rules hash comparison.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Reviewed delete protection and recovery posture
controls.environmentActual: Database delete protection and point-in-time recovery are disabled; version retention is one hour
controls.remediation: Approve and configure database recovery controls in a separate change.
controls.verification: Re-query database metadata and exercise the recovery runbook.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Gen2, Node 20, us-central1
controls.environmentActual: All nine scoped functions are ACTIVE Gen2 on nodejs20 in us-central1
controls.remediation: Keep runtime/region pinned in deployment configuration.
controls.verification: Re-list Functions after every release.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Production backend includes P1-P8 merged on 2026-08-03/04
controls.environmentActual: Scoped Functions were last updated 2026-07-23/24, before every P1-P8 merge; the Vercel frontend is at HEAD
controls.remediation: Create an authorized backend promotion plan only after all P0 configuration blockers are remediated.
controls.verification: Prove deployed source provenance/commit and repeat the full production configuration audit.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Per-surface maxInstances 3-20, concurrency 1-10, timeout 15-120 seconds
controls.environmentActual: Every scoped function has maxInstances 20 and concurrency 80; all except evaluateConversation have timeout 60 seconds
controls.remediation: Approve and deploy per-function limits from PUBLIC_INTAKE_LIMITS_V1.md.
controls.verification: Compare each deployed ServiceConfig field to the approved matrix.

controls.repositoryExpectation: No unrecognized allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers binding
controls.environmentActual: All nine underlying Cloud Run services have zero service-level bindings and no explicit public invoker
controls.remediation: Preserve explicit invoker review in release evidence.
controls.verification: Repeat service-level and project-level IAM queries.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Dedicated service account per trust boundary
controls.environmentActual: Eight of nine scoped functions use the default compute service account, which has project Editor; notifier uses a dedicated account
controls.remediation: Replace default identities with dedicated least-privilege runtime accounts and remove legacy Editor bindings.
controls.verification: Review IAM bindings and effective permissions per function.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Time-bound, audited break-glass instead of permanent personal Owner
controls.environmentActual: One redacted personal principal has project Owner; a redacted personal principal can act as the notifier service account
controls.remediation: Move to group/workload-based access, time-bound elevation, approval, and an audited break-glass runbook.
controls.verification: Re-query project and service-account IAM with personal identities redacted.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Zero user-managed production keys
controls.environmentActual: Key enumeration was denied for all four user-managed service accounts
controls.remediation: Grant metadata-only key-list permission to the auditor or provide independently attested key inventory.
controls.verification: Count USER_MANAGED keys without revealing key IDs.

controls.repositoryExpectation: HMAC, IP salt, and Gemini credentials exist in Secret Manager
controls.environmentActual: GEMINI_API_KEY has versions 1 and 2 enabled; IDEMPOTENCY_SECRET and IP_HASH_SALT each have version 1 enabled
controls.remediation: Assign version owners and rotation/retirement decisions; do not leave superseded versions enabled without justification.
controls.verification: List version state/date metadata and consumers.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Only dedicated consuming runtime accounts have secretAccessor
controls.environmentActual: All three secrets grant secretAccessor to the broad default compute service account
controls.remediation: Bind each secret only to its dedicated consuming service account.
controls.verification: Re-query secret IAM and deployed secret consumers.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Non-secret versioned configuration; secrets only in Secret Manager
controls.environmentActual: Tracked .env and .env.example contain Firebase variable names; remote Functions expose only environment-variable names and Secret Manager bindings; values were not read
controls.remediation: Document which web configuration is intentionally public, validate API-key restrictions, and remove stale runtime names.
controls.verification: Compare approved variable-name manifests per environment without reading values.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Active, unexpired PRODUCTION policy with bounded per-operation quotas
controls.environmentActual: No active pointer, policy, or audit documents exist
controls.remediation: Authorize and seed a reviewed immutable production policy through a trusted control plane.
controls.verification: Read active pointer/policy/audit metadata and exercise rollback in a non-production environment first.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Three attempts, bounded backoff, and platform-approved low fan-out
controls.environmentActual: Retry count/backoff align, but queue allows 500 dispatches/second and 1000 concurrent dispatches
controls.remediation: Approve and reduce queue rate/concurrency; define DLQ or equivalent recovery and backlog alerting.
controls.verification: Re-describe the queue and verify alert/runbook linkage.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Dedicated caller, fixed OIDC audience, authenticated gateway, idempotent bounded fan-out
controls.environmentActual: Source uses the dedicated notifier identity and fixed aura-maintenance-os audience; gateway has READY production deployments; gateway-side auth and environment variables were not verified
controls.remediation: Verify gateway auth, audience allowlist, provider quota, replay handling, and incident ownership.
controls.verification: Read gateway configuration and logs without invoking production.

controls.repositoryExpectation: No public bucket or default ACL
controls.environmentActual: No allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers bucket IAM, bucket ACL, or default object ACL was found
controls.remediation: Enable stronger preventive controls and retain periodic checks.
controls.verification: Re-query IAM and sanitized ACL principals without listing objects.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Uniform bucket-level access, enforced public access prevention, approved lifecycle/retention
controls.environmentActual: Uniform bucket-level access is false, public access prevention is inherited, no lifecycle/retention policy is present, and soft delete is seven days
controls.remediation: Approve UBLA, public-access prevention, report lifecycle, retention, and Preview/Production data isolation.
controls.verification: Re-describe bucket metadata and prove policy enforcement.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Five minutes in code, allowed range five to fifteen minutes
controls.environmentActual: Repository policy is five minutes; deployed Functions predate the certified contract, so effective behavior is not verified
controls.remediation: Verify deployed source provenance and signer permissions before enabling document delivery.
controls.verification: Use a non-production fake signer and deployment provenance; do not mint a production URL.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Sanitized events and aggregate metrics for P6/P7 controls
controls.environmentActual: Both telemetry and metrics collections contain zero documents while idempotency contains 49 documents
controls.remediation: Deploy verified telemetry with alerts only after backend/config blockers are closed.
controls.verification: Read aggregate counts and sanitized metric descriptors; never expose production payloads.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Thirty-day operational retention plus required audit retention
controls.environmentActual: Default log bucket retains 30 days; required bucket retains 400 days and is locked
controls.remediation: Document data classification and access ownership.
controls.verification: Re-list log bucket metadata.

controls.control: Dashboards, log metrics, and P0 alerting
controls.repositoryExpectation: Alerts for flooding, App Check, costs, errors, latency, conflicts, backlog, Storage, secrets, and IAM changes
controls.environmentActual: Zero user-defined log metrics, zero alert policies, and zero dashboards
controls.remediation: Create reviewed SLOs, metric descriptors, P0 alerts, owners, escalation, and runbook links.
controls.verification: List policies/dashboards and validate routing in a non-production exercise.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Owned thresholds, escalation, and containment for GCP, Gemini, Vercel, Storage, Tasks, and notifications
controls.environmentActual: Billing is enabled, but budget enumeration is denied; Gemini/Vercel/notification provider budgets are not evidenced
controls.remediation: Provide metadata-only budget evidence with owner, thresholds, escalation, and containment.
controls.verification: Re-list budgets and provider usage alerts without exposing spend details beyond approved metadata.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Production deploy comes from reviewed main commit
controls.environmentActual: Latest aura-control-center production deployment is READY from main at repository HEAD
controls.remediation: Retain deployment provenance evidence and add a backend compatibility gate.
controls.verification: Compare deployment commit to the certified release manifest.

controls.control: Vercel Preview isolation and automatic deployment
controls.repositoryExpectation: Preview cannot receive production backend/data configuration without an approved decision
controls.environmentActual: READY Preview deployments exist for audit/test and feature branches; remote variable names/targets and deployment protection could not be verified because the worktree is not linked
controls.remediation: Isolate Preview backend credentials, restrict branch deployment policy, and evidence deployment protection.
controls.verification: Read project environment metadata with a least-privilege Vercel auditor.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Audited Node 20 toolchain
controls.environmentActual: aura-control-center project reports Node 24.x while the certified runtime is Node 20.20.2
controls.remediation: Pin and certify the intended frontend Node runtime.
controls.verification: Re-list project metadata and compare build provenance.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Approved abuse, App Check, token, quota, cost, Firestore, queue, secret, IAM, and rollback procedures
controls.environmentActual: Only a future-operator containment runbook exists; dedicated incident procedures and escalation contacts are absent
controls.remediation: Create reviewed runbooks with owners, contacts, evidence preservation, containment, rollback, and verification.
controls.verification: Tabletop each procedure in non-production and record approvals.

controls.repositoryExpectation: Time-bound break-glass plus tested configuration rollback
controls.environmentActual: No operational break-glass runbook; no active production containment rollback pointer; local documentation explicitly describes future operations only
controls.remediation: Define, approve, and test break-glass and rollback before promotion.
controls.verification: Non-production exercise with time-bound access and immutable audit evidence.
